name: Hitsuji no Hakobune
source:
In 2104 a huge meteorite approaches the Earth in 7 days. The USA and their allies are unable to provide solution for this problem. At such time unrecognized genius gathers three talented people at an underground cellar. They need to decide which one of them sits in the shuttle and flies to the death trip to the meteorite.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2104年，一颗巨大的陨石将在七天后逼近地球。美国及其盟国都无法拿出解决方案。就在此时，一名不为人知的天才将三名才华出众的人召集到地下室。他们必须决定，究竟由谁登上穿梭机，踏上飞向陨石的必死之旅。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
